data.name: Manjula
data.gender_notes: Manjula is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Manjula is a beautiful and feminine name derived from Sanskrit. It means 'garland of gems'. In Hindu mythology, Manjula is the name of the goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth, prosperity, and fortune. She is depicted as adorned with precious gems and wearing a beautiful garland, symbolizing abundance and richness. The name Manjula carries the meaning “Garland of gems” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Manjula usually hope their child will grow to embody garland of gems and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the beauty and richness of the divine, inspiring inner abundance and prosperity.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Manjula total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
